corrections.text: The article states the clamp() RFC "argues a native implementation offers 'performance benefits'" while attributing this phrase to the RFC in quote marks. The word "benefit" does not appear anywhere on the cited RFC page (wiki.php.net/rfc/clamp_v2). The RFC's actual language is that a native function "would be even slightly faster than userland implementation using ternary, while providing some extra validation out of the box." The underlying claim is accurate; the quoted phrasing is a paraphrase, not the RFC's own words.
